title: Lloyds Bank and Bank of Scotland app outage, Nov 27, 2026
also_called: the Bank of Scotland app outage

subject.name: Lloyds Bank
subject.about: Lloyds Bank is a large British retail and commercial bank, founded in Birmingham in 1765. It is a key part of Lloyds Banking Group.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Lloyds Banking Group, Lloyds Bank, Bank of Scotland, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Lloyds Banking Group has more than 21 million mobile app users, and many Lloyds Bank and Bank of Scotland customers could not use the app or online banking on Nov 27. The bank has not said how many were affected.
who_is_affected: Lloyds Bank and Bank of Scotland customers who could not use the app or online banking on the morning of Nov 27. Lloyds says all its services are back; anyone still having trouble should wait a few minutes and try again. Nobody has said whether payments or data were affected.

known.text: Many Lloyds Bank customers could not log in to the app or online banking, make payments or check balances on the morning of Nov 27.
Bank of Scotland's app and online banking had problems too.
Lloyds says all its services are back up and running, and has given no cause.
Nobody has said the outage was a cyberattack.

not_known.text: Whether any customer data or payments were affected.
